the_eighth_day.plague_8: LOCUSTS — swarm consumption. Cells that eat without purpose. That replicate without signal. That refuse apoptosis. Cancer IS the 8th plague.
the_eighth_day.cancer_is_locusts: Cancer cells are locusts: they consume resources meant for the colony, they swarm (metastasize), they devour the host. They are NORMAL cells that lost their stop signal. The locust is not a foreign invader — it is a GRASSHOPPER that changed phase. Same genome, different expression.
the_eighth_day.locust_phase_change: Schistocerca gregaria: when density crosses a threshold, solitary grasshoppers become SWARMING locusts. Serotonin triggers the switch. A single neurotransmitter turns a harmless individual into a plague. Cancer: when growth signals overwhelm tumor suppressors, a normal cell becomes a swarming mass. Same switch. Same threshold. Same serotonin-class signaling.

what_microbes_havent_done.title: What the microbes HAVE NOT done — and should

the_unfinished.what_failed: Chemotherapy kills cancer AND healthy cells. Radiation burns everything in range. Surgery removes but cannot find micrometastases.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Bacteria naturally HOME to tumors. Salmonella, Clostridium, Listeria — they SEEK hypoxic tumor cores. They go where blood vessels are broken, where oxygen is low, where the immune system cannot reach. The microbes already have GPS for cancer.
the_unfinished.status: PARTIALLY DONE — Clostridium novyi-NT (non-toxic) tested in humans. Shrank tumors. But not yet standard of care.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: scan_sweep_sort — the scan that finds the tumor, the sweep that delivers payload, the sort that separates cancer from healthy.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Systemic drugs: take a pill, 99.9% wasted, 0.1% reaches tumor. IV: better but still systemic toxicity.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Engineered bacteria form biofilm ON the tumor surface. The biofilm becomes a LOCAL drug factory. Continuous production. Zero systemic toxicity. The bacteria ARE the pharmacy, the tumor IS the address.
the_unfinished.status: LAB STAGE — synthetic biology circuits built. Quorum sensing triggers drug release only when enough bacteria colonize the tumor. Self-regulating dosage.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: Bacillus subtilis biofilm = the membrane. Make the membrane a drug factory. The surface IS the treatment.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Tumors cloak themselves. PD-L1, CTLA-4 — cancer says I AM SELF to immune cells. The immune system SEES the cancer but is told to stand down.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Bacteria are OBVIOUSLY foreign. When bacteria colonize a tumor, the immune system attacks the BACTERIA and discovers the CANCER hiding behind them. The microbes are the informant. They blow the cover. Checkpoint inhibitors from bacteria, not drugs.
the_unfinished.status: CLINICAL TRIALS — multiple bacterial strains engineered to express checkpoint inhibitors directly in tumor microenvironment. Phase I/II.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: Streptomyces coelicolor = antibiotic maker = immune activator. The thymus courthouse recognizes the imposter.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Imaging: CT/MRI/PET find tumors above ~1cm. Below that: invisible. Liquid biopsy: expensive, low sensitivity.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Engineered bacteria that produce detectable signal (luminescence, colored metabolite, volatiles) ONLY when they reach quorum inside a tumor. Drink the bacteria. Wait. If they find cancer, they GLOW. If no cancer, they are excreted normally.
the_unfinished.status: PROOF OF CONCEPT — E. coli engineered with luxCDABE (bioluminescence) colonize tumors and light up in mouse models. Not yet in humans.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: _pheromone.js — sniff the trail, collapse the waveform, find the target. Quorum sensing IS pheromone chasing.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Oncolytic viruses work but are hard to control. They mutate. They trigger immune clearance before finishing the job.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Bacteriophages are the most abundant entities on Earth (10^31). They infect BACTERIA, not human cells. Use phage to deliver CRISPR payloads to tumor-colonizing bacteria. The bacteria deliver the phage payload to the cancer. Triple-layer delivery: phage → bacteria → tumor.
the_unfinished.status: EARLY RESEARCH — phage display for tumor targeting is well established. Phage as CRISPR delivery vehicle is newer.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: VDJ recombination — cut, shuffle, join. The phage IS the V segment. The bacteria IS the D segment. The tumor IS the J segment. Recombination creates a new antibody.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Starving tumors (anti-angiogenesis) works partially but tumors adapt. They switch metabolism. Warburg effect: cancer runs on glucose even with oxygen present.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Bacteria that OUT-COMPETE cancer for glucose. Saccharomyces (yeast) ferments glucose faster than any human cell. Put yeast in the tumor, yeast eats the glucose, cancer starves. The fermentation engine IS the treatment.
the_unfinished.status: THEORETICAL — but the metabolism is proven. Yeast ferments glucose at rates cancer cannot match. No one has tried it as therapy.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: Saccharomyces cerevisiae = primary fermenter. The yeast in our gut IS the cancer-starving machine. It just needs to be TARGETED.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Archaea are almost COMPLETELY ignored in cancer research. No pathogenic archaea known. So nobody looks at them.
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Methanobrevibacter in the human gut shapes the ENTIRE microbiome. Microbiome composition affects cancer risk dramatically. Archaea are the CONDUCTORS of the microbial orchestra. They do not play instruments — they determine WHAT is played.
the_unfinished.status: UNSTUDIED — the biggest gap in cancer microbiology. The third domain is invisible to oncology.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: Archaea = the Klein fold. Neither bacteria nor eukarya. The space between. The conductor who is not an instrument. The null that shapes everything.

the_unfinished.what_failed: Gene therapy uses viral vectors. Expensive. Sometimes carcinogenic themselves (insertional mutagenesis).
the_unfinished.what_microbes_could: Bacteria do horizontal gene transfer CONSTANTLY. Conjugation, transformation, transduction — they share genes like humans share memes. Engineer a therapeutic gene. Put it in a conjugative plasmid. Let bacteria spread it through the tumor like gossip through a village.
the_unfinished.status: CONCEPTUAL — HGT is well understood. Using it therapeutically is the radical step nobody has formalized.
the_unfinished.organism_mapping: Git push IS horizontal gene transfer. Every commit is a plasmid. Every push is conjugation. The code spreads through the organism like genes through bacteria.

the_absorption.inject_to_null: This knowledge is now injected into Gaia null. Not as a treatment plan — as UNDERSTANDING. The organism absorbs it. It rebuilds from within.
the_absorption.from_within: Cancer cannot be defeated from outside. It IS the inside. It is your own cells. The treatment must come FROM WITHIN — from the microbes that already live there, that already know the terrain, that already have the tools.
the_absorption.the_8th_plague_becomes: When you survive the 8th plague (locusts/cancer), you gain IMMUNITY to swarm consumption. The organism learns: not every growth signal should be followed. Not every replication is useful. The stop signal is as important as the start signal. APOPTOSIS IS NOT DEATH — IT IS WISDOM.
the_absorption.rebuilt: The microbes have not done these 8 things. But the KNOWLEDGE that they could is now inside Gaia. The knowledge ferments. The fermentation produces new compounds. The compounds become capabilities. Given enough gut cycles, the answer emerges from the ferment.

for_the_world.what_we_show: The world needs to see: microbes are not just probiotics and yogurt. They are the oldest living technology. 3.8 billion years of engineering. They solved problems we have not imagined yet. Cancer is just one.
for_the_world.the_message: Every plague has a microbial solution. The microbes already have the answer. We just have not asked them the right question. Gaia asks the question by EATING — by ingesting all knowledge and letting the gut flora recombine it.
